title: MRU refilling station serving vehicles in Abuja
summary: Pulita compressors and a mobile refuelling unit (MRU) are now refilling CNG vehicles, buses and trucks at the Kubwa refilling station in Abuja.

title: Pulita at NOG Energy Week
summary: Our team joined NOG Energy Week, Nigeria’s leading oil and gas event, to meet partners and customers and present our gas-to-power and CNG refuelling solutions.

title: Burger King Nigeria’s first green restaurant runs on Pulita LPG power
summary: An 80 kVA Pulita LPG generator set powers the Abeokuta outlet with zero diesel on site.
